name: store-counters
prompt: Support wants visibility into store traffic. Add three counters to Store, incremented in the existing methods (no behavior change otherwise): Created (number of successful Create calls), Lookups (number of Get calls, successful or not), Deletes (number of Delete calls). Expose them as a single method: func (s *Store) Counters() (created, lookups, deletes int64). Counters must be safe for concurrent use and start at zero. The counters are monotonically increasing.
